summary: The release manifest is now the single source of the project version and also publishes the DjangoLux version baked into the image.
highlights: release-manifest.json is the only project version source, read at runtime via get_project_version.
The published manifest label now carries the baked DjangoLux version, injected from the requirements pin.
Enrollment tokens pair from the UI with the control-panel URL, no redeploy required.
